items.ex: Water boils at 100°C. I study every morning.
I'm living with my aunt this year.

items.s: Present Perfect: past → now, no time
items.ex: Technology has changed education.
Sales fell in 2009.

items.s: Past Perfect: before another past event
items.ex: By 2010, the figure had doubled.

items.s: Future forms: will / going to / expected to
items.ex: It is expected to rise.
If taxes were lowered, people would spend more.

items.s: Check: one time frame per paragraph
items.ex: Zamonlarni sababsiz almashtirmang
Keep your nerve in the Speaking test.
I always get the jitters before exams.
Hold your head high — you've worked hard.
She rose to the occasion in the final.
I felt out of my depth in the advanced class.
A good mock is a real confidence boost.
Believe in yourself on exam day.

items.t: fake it till you make it
items.uz: ishonchli ko'rinib, keyin haqiqatda ishonchli bo'lmoq
items.ex: In Speaking, fake it till you make it — smile and speak.
When she talks about history, she's in her element.
Take a deep breath to steady your nerves.

Air quality deteriorated in winter.

The course encompasses all four skills.
Learning a language is a lifelong endeavour.
Traffic exacerbates air pollution.
Is it feasible to ban all cars?
Schools should foster creativity.
Poor roads hinder development.

items.s: Technology has made life more convenient, but …
items.ex: Technology has made life more convenient, but less personal.

items.uz: … ga haddan ortiq qaram bo'lib qoldik
items.ex: We've become overly dependent on our phones.
Social media cuts both ways.

items.s: Older people are often left behind.
items.ex: Older people are often left behind by technology.

items.s: Privacy is becoming a major concern.
items.ex: Privacy is becoming a major concern online.

items.s: It has opened up new opportunities for …
items.ex: It has opened up new opportunities for small businesses.
Face-to-face interaction is declining among teenagers.

items.s: It depends on how it's used.
items.ex: Ultimately, it depends on how it's used.

items.s: AI will change the job market dramatically.
items.ex: AI will change the job market dramatically.

items.s: Digital skills are now as basic as reading.
items.uz: Raqamli ko'nikmalar endi o'qish kabi asosiy
items.ex: Digital skills are now as basic as reading and writing.

items.w: a half / a third / a quarter
X rose steadily from A to B between … and …
items.ex: Sales rose steadily from 200 to 500 between 2000 and 2010.

items.w: X peaked at A in …, before declining to B
items.ex: It peaked at 80% in 2005, before declining to 60%.

items.w: X remained relatively stable at around A
items.ex: Prices remained relatively stable at around $50.

items.w: X and Y followed opposite trends
items.ex: Coal and gas followed opposite trends.

items.w: X overtook Y in … to become the most …
items.ex: Gas overtook coal in 2010 to become the main source.

items.w: There was a dramatic increase in X, which reached A
items.ex: There was a dramatic increase in users, which reached 2 million.

items.w: X fluctuated between A and B
items.ex: Visitor numbers fluctuated between 10 and 15 million.

items.w: By …, X had more than doubled
items.ex: By 2020, X had more than doubled.

items.w: X is projected to continue rising, reaching A by …
items.ex: It is projected to continue rising, reaching 90% by 2040.

items.w: Over the period as a whole, X increased by A
items.ex: Over the period as a whole, X increased by 40%.

task2.theme: Essay language: agree or disagree (opinion essays)

items.ex: I completely agree that children should learn cooking.

items.w: I strongly disagree with the idea that
items.ex: I strongly disagree with the idea that exams are useless.

items.w: While I accept that …, I believe
items.ex: While I accept that fees are high, I believe university is worth it.

items.w: This essay agrees for two reasons
items.uz: Ushbu insho ikki sababga ko'ra qo'shiladi
items.ex: This essay agrees for two main reasons.
The first reason is that it saves money.

items.w: Another reason why I hold this view is
items.uz: Bu fikrda bo'lishimning yana bir sababi
items.ex: Another reason why I hold this view is fairness.

items.w: Admittedly, some may argue that …; however,
items.ex: Admittedly, some may argue that it is costly; however, …

items.w: For these reasons, I firmly believe
items.ex: For these reasons, I firmly believe it should be compulsory.

items.w: State your position in the introduction
items.ex: Don't wait until the conclusion.
No surprise change of opinion.
